units.source_text: 女人垂下眼睛，闭上了嘴。

en.t: The woman lowered her eyes and closed her mouth.
What on earth was going on?

units.source_text: 门口上方，露出的那一小片天空，老早就碧蓝澄澈，

en.t: Above the doorway, the small patch of sky that showed through had long since turned clear and deep blue,

units.source_text: 像贝壳的肚子似的闪闪发光。

en.t: shimmering like the inside of a shell.

units.source_text: 就算“义务”那玩意儿是人的“护照”，

en.t: Even if that thing called duty is a person's passport,

units.source_text: 但为什么非得拿到那些家伙们发的“签证”呢！

en.t: why should one have to obtain a visa issued by those people?
...Life should not be scattered scraps of paper...

units.source_text: 应该是合得好好的一本日记……

en.t: It ought to be a diary properly bound together...

units.source_text: 最初的一页，即使每本只有一页也会有很多……

en.t: There would be many first pages, even if each book had only one page...

units.source_text: 直到与前页毫不相连的那一页为止，根本没有必要照顾情面……

en.t: Until reaching the page that has no connection at all with the one before it, there is absolutely no need to show consideration...

units.source_text: 即使对方已经快饿死了，也没有逐一去关心的闲暇……

en.t: Even if the other person is nearly starving to death, there is no time to worry about each one...

units.source_text: 可是，你想得到水，你就必须去兜圈子参加全部的死人葬礼，

en.t: But if you want water, you have to go the long way around and attend every dead person's funeral,

units.source_text: 你就是有再多的身体也分不过来嘛。

en.t: and no matter how many bodies you had, you still could not manage it all.
